KMISynth for Windows (64-bit, Windows 10 or later)
==================================================

The easiest way to install is the Setup .exe published next to this zip. To install by hand:

  KMISynth.vst3   copy to  C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  KMISynth.exe    the standalone app: run it from anywhere

Then restart your DAW and rescan plugins.

This release is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn when you run the installer or the app:
choose "More info", then "Run anyway".

KMISynth is free software under the GNU AGPLv3 (see LICENSE).
